author: Vox
description:
A sinkhole opened in Nicolas Cage’s driveway in Malibu. And with about one-third of Americans living on the coast, could your property be next? Vox’s Sara Herschander explains how climate change and erosion on our coasts increasingly lead to sinkholes.
